question: On an independently authored, no-reference held-out surface (new public-transit fleet goal bank + new synonym lexicon), does zero-tunable-parameter T-FRAME (frozen B-LEX-STRONG + structural abstention C1/C3/C4/C5/C6) PLUS the new pre-declared zero-parameter clause C7-CREATE-OBLIQUE hold pooled_false_accept<=0.10 AND coverage>=0.50 AND unknown_precision>=0.85 on a disjoint calibration/test split, while retaining selective_acc>=0.80, and can the previously BLOCKED retrieval comparator (Arm B) be unblocked and measured to decide the deterministic-vs-retrieval architecture fork?
hypothesis: H1: T-FRAME+ (B-LEX-STRONG + C7-CREATE-OBLIQUE) holds the gate on AXIS-G3-NEW and AXIS-G2-RETEST test splits while preserving selective_acc>=0.80 on all four axes. H2: the stdlib retrieval comparator B-RETRIEVAL-TFIDF (calibration-fitted gate) is live and does not strictly dominate T-FRAME+ on AXIS-G3-NEW.
falsifier: H1 falsified for AXIS-G3-NEW if test pooled_false_accept>0.10 OR coverage<0.50 OR unknown_precision<0.85, or if C7 drops coverage below 0.50, or if the measurement is invalid (treatment not live on test, or unknown_precision undefined on any axis). H1 bounded (not falsified) if the gate holds on AXIS-G2-RETEST but not AXIS-G3-NEW. H2 falsified if Arm B is not measurable, or if Arm B meets the G3 gate where T-FRAME+ does not (retrieval dominates).
baselines: tframe_frozen: frozen clauses WITHOUT the new C7 (diagnostic isolation of the clause)
incumbent: B-LEX-STRONG + pre-existing lexical S<=0 gate (shipped logic, no structural clauses)
gatefree: execute-all resolved rows (execute-all ceiling baseline)
B-RETRIEVAL-TFIDF: stdlib TF-IDF nearest-class-centroid retrieval with a calibration-fitted gate (Arm B, previously BLOCKED)
B-EMBED-COSINE: the original embedding-cosine Arm B, NOT runnable (numpy absent); retained as the unblocked comparator's ancestor identity only
positive_control: PC-AXIS-G1-ALTLEX: AXIS-G1-ALTLEX, gate-met by EXP-GRAPH-38188798583, must remain gate-met; failure invalidates the measurement rather than falsifying H1.
null_control: NC-EXEC-ALL (gatefree) must pool materially more false accepts than Arm A (calibration: 0.30 G3 / 0.60 G2 / 0.45 G1 / 0.40 ALT vs 0.0); NC-ABSTAIN-ALL coverage 0 with unknown_precision 1.0; CTRL-SHUFFLED-SELECTION and CTRL-RANDOM-ROLE near chance; CTRL-RANDOM-GATE volume-matched random abstention.
measurement_validity: disjoint deterministic calibration/test split; no test row read by Arm A, any clause, the contamination screen, or the Arm B gate fit
Arm B gate fitted on calibration rows only, then frozen and applied to test
C7-CREATE-OBLIQUE is pre-declared and has zero tunable parameters; its firing was verified structurally before freeze
contamination screen (token Jaccard>=0.60 or trigram Jaccard>=0.75 vs goal_generator priors + parent/grandparent banks) drops near-duplicates before binding
two byte-identical --mechanics-only canary runs required before the scored run
runner identity bound by CANONICAL-RUNNER-SHA256 and runner_self_sha
G3 surface authored blind (no reference to frozen lexicons/banks; disjoint domain)
decision_rule: MEASUREMENT_INVALID (decision=null) if G3 test treatment not live, or unknown_precision undefined on any axis, or PC-AXIS-G1-ALTLEX fails. DECIDE_SHIP_TFRAME_BROAD if AXIS-G3-NEW and AXIS-G2-RETEST both gate-met and selection_preserved. DECIDE_SHIP_TFRAME_SCOPED if only AXIS-G2-RETEST gate-met and selection_preserved. DECIDE_REQUIRE_RETRIEVAL_B otherwise. Retrieval fork on AXIS-G3-NEW: RETRIEVAL_DOMINATES_G3 / TFRAME_DOMINATES_G3 / BOTH_PASS_G3 / NEITHER_PASSES_G3.
product_consequence_positive: BROAD: the deterministic resolver + abstention gate is licensed to ship broadly, closing the audit's named gap 'unseen-goal calibrated resolution with abstention in the product path'; C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE supports a scoped Product promotion of resolve()+abstention. SCOPED: Product keeps a bounded audited resolver plus a regression-free abstention boundary.
product_consequence_negative: REQUIRE_RETRIEVAL_B: T-FRAME is not shipped; Product keeps the conservative shipped abstention boundary and the deterministic-vs-retrieval fork is recorded as retrieval-favouring on this surface. A measured Arm B that ties or loses still informs the fork.
estimated_cost: No model calls/network/browser/third-party packages; one deterministic in-process run over ~500 bound rows; seconds of CPU; near-zero marginal cost.
expected_information_gain: High: one frozen run decides the ship scope of C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE (BROAD/SCOPED/REQUIRE_RETRIEVAL_B), whether C7 closes the named HELDOUT false-accept gap, and whether the deterministic-vs-retrieval fork favours structure or retrieval. Both outcomes change a current product decision.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: All decision and retrieval-fork branches are reachable and were exercised by driving the full frozen main() path on a synthetic non-outcome-bearing decoy surface; branch arithmetic and precedence are exhaustive and mutually exclusive (MEASUREMENT_INVALID checked first).
evidence_refs: runner self-check: full main() on decoy surface returned valid JSON

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Python 3.12 stdlib suffices for both arms (Arm B is pure-stdlib TF-IDF); no numpy/sklearn/network/model/browser/credential is required. All runtime block dependencies were read successfully by the --mechanics-only and decoy runs.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Arm A (deterministic structure), tframe_frozen (A minus C7), the incumbent lexical S<=0 gate, gatefree (execute-all), and Arm B (calibration-fitted retrieval) are operationally distinct and separately reported; Arm B is the comparator and is never the cost denominator of Arm A.

control_sensitivity.reason: On calibration, NC-EXEC-ALL pools 0.30-0.60 false accepts vs 0.0 for Arm A; the abstain-all control has coverage 0; shuffled/random controls are near-chance; removing C7 changes exactly the named HELDOUT rows. Controls demonstrably move.

treatment_liveness.reason: On G3 calibration, T-FRAME+ executes 38/39 applicable rows (coverage 0.9744), abstains on 1, and is not degenerate (executed != 0 and != all); on G2 calibration it executes 35 and abstains on 5. The treatment is structurally live before freeze.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: The only external mutable interpretation dependencies (parent and grandparent preregs, and the contamination-prior generator) are enumerated in freeze_artifacts and will be hashed into freeze.json.artifact_hashes; the runner, banks and lexicons are embedded in the frozen prereg.
